title: Orsen and the Lantern
author: Xanthe Ashgrove
blurb: Wren Blackwood, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the century turns.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
